facts.fact: The study authors state that all 16 outpatient facilities of the private social enterprise Penda Health in Nairobi and Kiambu counties used a cloud-based electronic health record system, recording 78,366 clinical consultations between 1 July and 30 September 2024; no denominator of clinics is given.
facts.system: Penda Health EMR (Easy Clinic cloud-based electronic health record)

facts.fact: The study authors describe the facilities using the EMR as Level 3a and 3b facilities, 24/7 outpatient urgent and primary care centres staffed mainly by clinical officers, in a private urban network, July to September 2024; no hospital or public-sector use is stated.
facts.system: Penda Health EMR (Easy Clinic cloud-based electronic health record)

facts.fact: The study describes clinicians entering symptoms, vital signs, history, examination and tests into the EMR during the patient encounter and reviewing the embedded decision-support output in real time during the consultation, July to September 2024.
facts.system: Penda Health EMR (Easy Clinic cloud-based electronic health record)

facts.fact: The study states the EMR is a cloud-based system developed by Easy Clinic (India) and run by the private social enterprise Penda Health across its own network in 2024; no ministry role in the system is stated.
facts.system: Penda Health EMR (Easy Clinic cloud-based electronic health record)

systems.system: Penda Health EMR (Easy Clinic cloud-based electronic health record)
